who was napoleon bonaparte

Napoleon Bonaparte was a French military leader and emperor who rose to prominence during the French Revolution, ruling France from 1799 to 1814 and briefly in 1815. He expanded French influence across Europe, instituted the Napoleonic Code, and was defeated at Waterloo.
